prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] at a signalized intersection. Our client was proceeding through the intersection on a green light when your insured drove into the side of our client's vehicle after failing to yield. The force of the impact spun our client's car and caused it to strike a curb before coming to rest.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a fracture of the wrist. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, immobilization, and orthopedic follow-up, and our client continues to experience pain, restricted grip strength, and limitations in daily activities. Medical records and imaging documenting these injuries are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear. The police report identifies your insured as the party who failed to yield, and independent witness statements support our client's account of the signal. We see no reasonable basis on which to dispute fault.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.
